manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Lift the silver laptop using the left arm

Task description: The object is the silver laptop at the center of the table, with a black logo on its lid. Use the left arm to lift the lid farther open around its hinge while keeping the base on the table.

Success criteria: The laptop lid is opened through at least forty percent of the hinge's full travel, while the left end effector remains near the designated interaction contact point. Merely raising the lid to a narrow gap above the base is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping the lid's free edge away from the hinge at a straight section away from corners. Contact the outer shell and rigid inner bezel to reduce opening force and avoid squeezing the screen.
- Set the gripper opening to fit the lid thickness and existing gap. Before closing, check from an oblique side view that the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the lid, avoiding a missed grasp caused by gripping the base as well or merely overlapping in the image.
- As the lid rotates around its hinge during lifting, make small adjustments to the end-effector position and pose rather than pulling vertically continuously or pushing toward the hinge, which could cause slipping or jamming.
